Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): RITES Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: Consignee 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Eligibility Criteria: Only Manufacturers or their authorized dealers/ distributors (except for Q1 & Q2 categ ory) need to quote with bid specific authorization from the manufacturers failing which offer will be summa rily rejected. In case bidders participate as an authorized agent, then the performance as required above shall be that o f the Principal, authorizing the agent. It may so happen that the agent has credentials of past supply for a d ifferent Principal but this will not be considered as performance for placing bulk order in case of change of Principal. The Bidder should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 20% of bid quantity , in at least on e of the last three financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PS U / Public Listed Company. Copies of relevant contracts (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in an y one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant financial year. The similar product category will be the bid item having same description, but of different sizes/ratin gs/capacities. The bidder is required to submit proof of successful supply. Purchase order alone shall not b

e considered as work experience. In case of any documents submitted by bidders are found to be forged o r fake, the concerned bidder shall be debarred for future purchases and the action of suspension from the Ge M shall also be initiated. The onus of submission of requisite documents such as copies CRAC, CRN, Receipt note shall be responsibi lity of the bidder. 2. Payment Terms:-100% Payment after supply, inspection and acceptance by Consignee. 3. Warranty (Complete unit with blower motor):- 03 Years. 4. In compliance of Make in India Purchase Preference Policy, Make in India Declaration form OEM must be uploaded along with offer, otherwise offer will be summarily rejected. 5. Inspection by RITES. 6.Material will be supply and installation at different location of running rooms: MB-02 , ROZA-02, BLM-01 , BE-01, CH-01 , HPU-01 , HW-01, DDN-01 ,NBD-01. 7. Specification attached in bid ATC document, material will be supply as per enclosed specification in bid ATC. 8.No fresh documents will be accepted after bid opening also not be accepted in representation. . 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Sr.DFM/MB . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date
